summary: Steel Aermotor lookout in Beauregard Parish, Louisiana, built in the early 1950s and removed by 2021; a former lookout site since 2022.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower with a 7 x 7 ft metal cab
facts.agency: Louisiana Department of Agriculture and Forestry
facts.status_note: Removed by 2021 per the register; Wikipedia estimates 2015 to 2016 from aerial imagery. Now listed as a former lookout site.

events.note: Registered September 1, 1999 as US 322, LA 3; nominated by Keith Hawkins
Estimate only: Wikipedia says it appears to have been torn down between 2015 and 2016, judging from old aerial imagery
Register says removed by 2021; no exact date found
Added to the former lookout sites register May 22, 2022 as US 2085, LA 6

corrections.why: Both registers say the tower was removed by 2021, and the 2022 former-site register lists it as a former site. Wikipedia's list says torn down.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1999 NHLR entry was made while the tower stood. The register later records it as removed by 2021, and the former-site register (2022) lists it as a former site.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: The register's only removal date is 'by 2021'. Wikipedia's Merryville row estimates removal between 2015 and 2016 from old aerial imagery; this fits 'by 2021' but is not confirmed, so no removal year is certain. No built year beyond 'early 1950s', so no built event was entered. No staffing, fire or access information found in the sources read; the Central US Lookouts Merryville page is only a heading. The record's status 'standing' is contradicted by both registers and Wikipedia (proposed correction). The Wikipedia 'Torn down.' quote is taken from the Merryville row of the list.
